description: Chimege Systems LLC is an Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia company building Mongolian-language speech technology. It sells a Mongolian speech-to-text and text-to-speech REST API alongside end-user products (Chimege Writer, Reader, Duudan, Protocol, Sub, Keyboard) and the IVA virtual-agent platform. API tokens are issued after a service agreement; prices are published in MNT.
name: Chimege
